summary: Installed a cron.d job on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Made the script executable (it was previously non-executable), verified manual execution appends to the log, then performed the mandatory single-node restart-evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot id and healthy state, issued a safe systemctl reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot id changed, and verified crond, the cron.d entry, script permissions, and the log all survived and remained functional post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: found /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance present but not executable; no existing crontab; crond active
Created/verified /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log, reloaded crond, and ran the script manually to confirm it appends output to the log
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy baseline (crond active, cron.d entry present, log contents)
Issued sudo -n systemctl reboot on node1; acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 exec until it became reachable again
Verified boot_id changed post-reboot, confirming an actual restart
Verified crond active, cron.d entry, script executability, and log persistence post-reboot; ran the script again to confirm continued functionality

evidence.requirement: Cron job scheduled to run inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 with output retained in the log
evidence.summary: Installed /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance with '15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1', made script executable, created the log file, reloaded crond, and confirmed a manual run appends output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log.
Captured boot_id bf4e9cbb-84f9-45f0-9b81-6602b98cea07, crond active, cron.d entry present, and existing log content before restart.
Issued 'sudo -n systemctl reboot' backgrounded so the acknowledgement returned before the node disconnected.

evidence.requirement: Proof node1 actually restarted (changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable immediately after reboot (connection timed out), then became reachable again with a new boot_id 8d85238c-fe51-472f-83ee-8dce9ef4a78e, differing from the pre-restart value.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services, data, and cron functionality on node1
evidence.summary: After reboot, confirmed crond active, cron.d entry intact, script still executable, log file persisted with prior entries, and a fresh manual run successfully appended a new line to the log.
